note: Walk-forward: every input for week W (weekly roster, injuries, team drives / play-by-play / td-share fits, recent usage, prior-season rates) uses data before W only. Hit = a top-4 pick scored a rushing or receiving TD. The sims read no betting-market data (no Vegas totals, spreads, implied totals, win probabilities, Sleeper or sportsbook prices); assertMarketFree throws otherwise. driveNew / pbp2New = 4.14.0 sims (nflverse weekly roster as the pre-game roster, a player's rates carried across a team change, rookie / depth priors, 1% per-player floor); drive4131 / pbp4131 = 4.13.1 as shipped; driveNew includes a per-game team TD multiplier (Gamma, sd 0.18) for each team; drive413 / pbp413 = 4.13.0 (model inputs + TD-budget anchor, comparison only). model = shipped anytime chance and sleeper = published price, both comparison baselines only, never sim inputs; naive = season TD leaders. Sims pick from the whole pre-game roster; anytime = Brier / log loss over the model's player universe (comparable with model / sleeper), anytimeRosterPool = over the full pre-game roster (players a sim did not list count as 0). Role = anyone outside QB1 / RB1 / WR1 / WR2 / TE1 of the 4.14 depth order.
